facts.text: Half Moon is set on 400 acres with two miles of private beachfront.
facts.excerpt: Set on 400 acres of land of wood and water, with two miles of private beachfront

facts.text: Half Moon calls itself Jamaica's highest-rated resort.
facts.excerpt: Half Moon is Jamaica’s highest-rated resort, a biophilic sanctuary where space and privacy are our intention and your luxury

facts.text: Most of Half Moon's accommodations have sea views.
facts.excerpt: Individually appointed accommodations, most with sweeping sea views

facts.text: Eclipse at Half Moon is framed by the Caribbean Sea to the north and lush hillsides to the south.
facts.excerpt: Framed by the glistening Caribbean Sea to the north and the lush hillsides to the south, Eclipse at Half Moon

facts.text: Eclipse has an infinity-edge swimming pool and a private beachfront with a natural swimming cove.
facts.excerpt: a sweeping infinity-edge swimming pool, and private beachfront with a natural swimming cove

facts.text: Eclipse is home to Fern Tree, a Salamander Spa.
facts.excerpt: Fern Tree – a Salamander Spa

facts.text: Spa guests can choose an overwater cabana for their treatment.
facts.excerpt: for absolute relaxation choose an overwater cabana experience for your treatment

facts.text: The spa's therapies combine indigenous ingredients with international brands and techniques.
facts.excerpt: Revel in a menu of exceptional therapies that combine indigenous ingredients and the best of international brands and techniques.

facts.text: The spa offers a Jamaican Bush Bath steeped with fresh herbs, roots, leaves and fruits.
facts.excerpt: This bath steeped with fresh herb and roots, leaves and fruits used in this traditional Jamaican experience known for its healing.

facts.text: Founders Cove was established in 1954.

facts.text: Founders Cove began with ten cottages.
facts.excerpt: With a limited number of exclusive “cottages” – ten, to be precise

facts.text: The villas are fully staffed with a cook, housekeeper and butler, and each has a private pool.

facts.text: The villas are 15 minutes from Montego Bay's Sangster International Airport.

facts.text: Estate Ocean Suites sit in private Estate Houses surrounded by tropical gardens.
facts.excerpt: They are situated in private Estate Houses, surrounded by tropical gardens.
